summary.short: Italian data protection authority decision of 2 November 2024 fining OpenAI OpCo LLC €15,000,000 for GDPR breaches in its ChatGPT service (conduct from 30 November 2022 to 30 March 2023). It also orders a six-month information campaign and transmits part of the file to the Irish authority.
summary.long: Decision no. 755 of 2 November 2024 by the Italian data protection authority (Garante) under the GDPR, addressed to OpenAI OpCo LLC over its ChatGPT service. The proceeding followed a 20 March 2023 data breach and an urgent provisional limitation of processing of data of persons in Italy (order 112/2023, 30 March 2023). Order 114/2023 (11 April 2023) suspended that limitation on conditions covering an information notice, opt-out and rectification tools, an age gate, an age verification plan and a public information campaign. The decision finds breaches of: notification of the breach to the authority (Art. 33); the accountability principle and the lawful-basis requirement for training data (Arts. 5(2), 6), for conduct from 30 November 2022; transparency duties (Arts. 5(1)(a), 12, 13); protection of minors through age verification (Arts. 24, 25(1)); and non-compliance with an order (Art. 83(5)(e)). The accuracy principle (Art. 5(1)(d)) was not sanctioned and the file was sent to the Irish authority. Fines total €9,000,000, €320,000 and €5,680,000 across three groupings. The accessory measure is a six-month institutional communication campaign on Italian media with content approved by the Garante. The operative part lists Art. 32, while the reasoning finds a breach of Art. 33.

notes: The registry metadata gives status struck_down; the document itself records no judicial outcome, so that status is not verified by this text. The operative part lists infringements of arts. 5(1)(a) and 5(2), 6, 12, 13, 24, 25 and 32, while the motivation finds breaches of arts. 33, 5(2), 6, 5(1)(a), 12, 13, 24, 25 and 83(5)(e) and refers art. 5(1)(d) to the Irish authority; art. 32 appears only in the operative part and arts. 33 and 83(5)(e) only in the motivation. The order is cited as art. 83(5) lett. e) in the heading of section 6.5 but as lett. d) in several passages of the same section. Yoti is called a US company in one passage and an English company with UK data processing elsewhere. The 1/2019 procedural regulation is cited once as n. 1/2000. The fine components (9,000,000 + 320,000 + 5,680,000) sum to the stated 15,000,000. Target instrument IDs are left empty where registry IDs were not supplied; the GDPR and the Codice are not identified in the registry by this annotation.

enforcement.authority: Garante per la protezione dei dati personali
enforcement.triggered_by: Violations found by the Garante: Arts. 5(1)(a), 5(2), 6, 12, 13, 24 and 25(1) (treated as one connected conduct under Art. 83(3)); Art. 33 (breach notification); Art. 83(5)(e) (non-compliance with the order in point 9 of provv. n. 114/2023). The operative part lists Arts. 5(1)(a), 5(2), 6, 12, 13, 24, 25 and 32 and omits Arts. 33 and 83(5)(e), which the reasoning finds.
enforcement.max_penalty_text: Up to EUR 20 million or, for undertakings, up to 4% of total worldwide annual turnover of the preceding year (Art. 83(5)(e), as quoted in the decision)
enforcement.penalty_formula: Imposed total EUR 15,000,000 (about 1.58% of 2023 worldwide turnover): EUR 9,000,000 for the connected conduct (Arts. 5(1)(a), 5(2), 6, 12, 13, 24, 25(1)); EUR 320,000 for Art. 33; EUR 5,680,000 for Art. 83(5)(e). Art. 83(3) caps the total at the amount for the most serious violation.
enforcement.penalty_reference: GDPR Art. 83(3), 83(4), 83(5)(e); Codice art. 166, comma 8 (payment reduction)
enforcement.cure_period: Paying half the fine within 60 days settles the dispute (Codice art. 166, comma 8); opposition to the ordinary court within 30 days of notification (GDPR Art. 78)

evidence.provision: Operative part (TUTTO CIÒ PREMESSO), ORDINA a); Sec. 7; Sec. 6.5

enforcement.cure_period: Campaign plan to be submitted within 60 days of notification; campaign to start within 45 days of Garante approval of the plan; information on implementation within 60 days after the campaign ends
